evidence: Zirconium tetrachloride /H20849ZrCl4, kept at 150°C and carried by N2/H20850and hafnium tetrachloride /H20849HfCl4, kept at 150°C and carried by N2/H20850were used as the metal precursors, and H2O was used as the oxidizing agent.
